scope: supplemental full Autobahn fuzzingserver client-side run (not the digest-locked PyPy gate)

toolchain.note: This environment is not the gate's digest-locked PyPy 7.3.20 identity. Docker/Podman and the locked PyPy archive are unavailable on this host.

testee_protocol: Echo every complete text or binary message

compression.offer: permessage-deflate with context takeover, client_max_window_bits=15 and server_max_window_bits=15
compression.effect: Without explicit window-bit offers the 72 cases 13.3.x-13.6.x were reported UNIMPLEMENTED; with the offers they all passed.

conclusions: All 517 Autobahn Testsuite 25.10.1 client cases executed against the netz WebSocket client with zero failed, zero non-strict and zero unimplemented results.
The three INFORMATIONAL results are the suite's expected close-behavior cases 7.1.6, 7.13.1 and 7.13.2 with close codes 1000/1002.
Explicit client/server window-bit offers are required for the 13.3-13.6 compression cases; the adapter now offers both at 15.
This is supplemental evidence: the strict repository gate still requires the digest-locked PyPy identity or the container image.
